import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 10, "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "text.color": "#263238", "axes.labelcolor": "#263238", "axes.edgecolor": "#657786", "xtick.color": "#657786", "ytick.color": "#657786", "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False, "axes.linewidth": 0.8, "svg.fonttype": "none", })
n = np.arange(4) x = np.array([2, 1, 0, 3]) components = np.diag(x) if not np.array_equal(components.sum(axis=0), x): raise ValueError("The basis components must sum to the supplied signal.")
ink = "#263238" slate = "#657786" colors = ["#33658A", "#2A9D8F", slate, "#9273B5"]
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(9.8, 4.2), dpi=100) fig.suptitle( "Discrete signal as a sum of scaled standard basis vectors", x=0.51, y=0.965, fontsize=14, fontweight="medium", )
ax_signal = fig.add_axes([0.075, 0.29, 0.245, 0.49]) positions = [ [0.485, 0.615, 0.195, 0.185], [0.790, 0.615, 0.195, 0.185], [0.485, 0.265, 0.195, 0.185], [0.790, 0.265, 0.195, 0.185], ] axes_components = [fig.add_axes(pos) for pos in positions]
def configure_axes(ax, small=False): ax.set_xlim(-0.38, 3.38) ax.set_ylim(-0.18, 3.65) ax.set_xticks(n) ax.set_yticks([0, 1, 2, 3]) ax.tick_params( axis="both", labelsize=8 if small else 10, length=3, width=0.8, pad=3, ) ax.spines["bottom"].set_position(("data", 0)) ax.spines["left"].set_color("#A5AFB4") ax.spines["bottom"].set_color("#A5AFB4") ax.set_axisbelow(True)
def draw_component(ax, values, active_index, color): inactive = n != active_index ax.plot( n[inactive], values[inactive], linestyle="none", marker="o", markersize=4.5, markerfacecolor="white", markeredgecolor="#B7C0C5", markeredgewidth=1.0, zorder=3, ) ax.vlines( active_index, 0, values[active_index], color=color, linewidth=2.2, zorder=3, ) ax.plot( active_index, values[active_index], "o", color=color, markersize=5.5, zorder=4, ) ax.annotate( str(values[active_index]), (active_index, values[active_index]), xytext=(0, 6), textcoords="offset points", ha="center", va="bottom", color=color, fontsize=10, fontweight="medium", )
configure_axes(ax_signal) ax_signal.vlines(n, 0, x, color=ink, linewidth=2.2, zorder=3) ax_signal.plot(n, x, "o", color=ink, markersize=6, zorder=4) for index, value in zip(n, x): ax_signal.annotate( str(value), (index, value), xytext=(0, 8), textcoords="offset points", ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=11, ) ax_signal.set_title( r"$\mathbf{x}=[2,\ 1,\ 0,\ 3]^{\mathsf{T}}$", fontsize=13, pad=15, ) ax_signal.set_xlabel(r"Sample index $n$", labelpad=9) ax_signal.set_ylabel(r"Amplitude $x[n]$", labelpad=9)
titles = [ r"$2\,\mathbf{e}_0=[2,0,0,0]^{\mathsf{T}}$", r"$1\,\mathbf{e}_1=[0,1,0,0]^{\mathsf{T}}$", r"$0\,\mathbf{e}_2=[0,0,0,0]^{\mathsf{T}}$", r"$3\,\mathbf{e}_3=[0,0,0,3]^{\mathsf{T}}$", ] for i, ax in enumerate(axes_components): configure_axes(ax, small=True) draw_component(ax, components[i], i, colors[i]) ax.set_title(titles[i], fontsize=10.5, color=colors[i], pad=7) if i >= 2: ax.set_xlabel(r"Sample index $n$", fontsize=9, labelpad=5)
fig.text(0.390, 0.540, r"$=$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=29) fig.text(0.735, 0.710, r"$+$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=23) fig.text(0.438, 0.350, r"$+$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=23) fig.text(0.735, 0.350, r"$+$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=23)
fig.text( 0.53, 0.065, r"$\mathbf{x}=2\,\mathbf{e}_0+1\,\mathbf{e}_1" r"+0\,\mathbf{e}_2+3\,\mathbf{e}_3$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=16, )
